description: This source file defines a utility class 'TensorFlow' providing static methods to interact with the TensorFlow runtime, including retrieving version info, loaded operations, and loading dynamic libraries.

classes.name: TensorFlow
classes.description: A final utility class containing static native methods for TensorFlow runtime operations, such as version retrieval, library loading, and registered operation listing.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the underlying TensorFlow runtime.

methods.name: registeredOpList
methods.description: Returns a serialized OpList protocol buffer containing all available TensorFlow operations.

methods.name: loadLibrary
methods.description: Loads a native library file, registers its operations, and returns the serialized OpList protobuf. Handles native library loading errors.
